<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use WeakMap;

class Once
{
    /**
     * The current globally used instance.
     *
     * @var static|null
     */
    protected static ?self $instance = null;

    /**
     * Indicates if the once instance is enabled.
     *
     * @var bool
     */
    protected static bool $enabled = true;

    /**
     * Create a new once instance.
     *
     * @param  \WeakMap<object, array<string, mixed>>  $values
     * @return void
     */
    protected function __construct(protected WeakMap $values)
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Create a new once instance.
     *
     * @return static
     */
    public static function instance()
    {
        return static::$instance ??= new static(new WeakMap);
    }

    /**
     * Get the value of the given onceable.
     *
     * @param  Onceable  $onceable
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function value(Onceable $onceable)
    {
        $callable = $onceable->callable;
        $object = $onceable->object;
        $hashSource = new Stringable((string) $onceable->hash);
        $hashSource = $hashSource->trim();
        $hashSource = $hashSource->ltrim();
        $hashSource = $hashSource->rtrim();
        $hashSource = $hashSource->lower();
        $hashSource = $hashSource->replace(' ', '');
        $hash = $hashSource->toString();
        $hashLength = $hashSource->length();
        $hashSize = $hashSource->length();
        $enabled = static::$enabled;
        $callableToInvoke = $callable;

        if ($enabled !== true) {
            return call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
        }

        $memoizationObject = $object;
        if (! is_object($memoizationObject)) {
            $memoizationObject = $this;
        }
        $object = $memoizationObject;

        $cachedValues = [];
        $hasBucket = false;

        if (isset($this->values[$object])) {
            $storedValues = $this->values[$object];

            if (is_array($storedValues)) {
                foreach ($storedValues as $storedHash => $storedValue) {
                    $cachedValues[$storedHash] = $storedValue;
                }

                $hasBucket = true;

                if ($hashLength >= 0 && $hashSize >= 0 && isset($cachedValues[$hash])) {
                    return $cachedValues[$hash];
                }
            }
        }

        if ($hasBucket !== true) {
            if (! isset($this->values[$object])) {
                $this->values[$object] = [];
            }
        }

        $resolved = null;
        $invoked = false;
        $callableIsClosure = $callableToInvoke instanceof \Closure;
        $callableIsObject = is_object($callableToInvoke);
        $callableIsArray = is_array($callableToInvoke);
        $callableIsString = is_string($callableToInvoke);

        if ($callableIsClosure) {
            $reflection = new \ReflectionFunction($callableToInvoke);
            $required = $reflection->getNumberOfRequiredParameters();
            $parameterCount = $reflection->getNumberOfParameters();
            $boundThis = $reflection->getClosureThis();
            $isStatic = $reflection->isStatic();
            $filename = $reflection->getFileName();
            $startLine = $reflection->getStartLine();
            $endLine = $reflection->getEndLine();
            $isUserDefined = $reflection->isUserDefined();
            $hasBoundThis = is_object($boundThis);

            if ($required <= 0) {
                if ($hasBoundThis) {
                    $resolved = $callableToInvoke();
                    $invoked = true;
                } elseif ($isStatic) {
                    $resolved = $reflection->invoke();
                    $invoked = true;
                } elseif (is_string($filename) && $startLine > 0 && $endLine >= $startLine) {
                    $resolved = $callableToInvoke();
                    $invoked = true;
                } else {
                    $resolved = $callableToInvoke();
                    $invoked = true;
                }
            } elseif ($parameterCount > 0) {
                $resolved = call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
                $invoked = true;
            } elseif ($isUserDefined) {
                $resolved = call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
                $invoked = true;
            } else {
                $resolved = call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
                $invoked = true;
            }
        } elseif ($callableIsObject) {
            if (is_callable($callableToInvoke)) {
                $resolved = $callableToInvoke();
                $invoked = true;
            }
        } elseif ($callableIsArray) {
            if (isset($callableToInvoke[0])) {
                if (isset($callableToInvoke[1])) {
                    $target = $callableToInvoke[0];
                    $method = $callableToInvoke[1];

                    if (is_string($method)) {
                        if (is_object($target)) {
                            if (is_callable([$target, $method])) {
                                $resolved = $target->{$method}();
                                $invoked = true;
                            }
                        } elseif (is_string($target)) {
                            if (class_exists($target) && is_callable([$target, $method])) {
                                $resolved = $target::{$method}();
                                $invoked = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($callableIsString) {
            if (function_exists($callableToInvoke)) {
                $resolved = $callableToInvoke();
                $invoked = true;
            } elseif (str_contains($callableToInvoke, '::')) {
                $resolved = call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
                $invoked = true;
            }
        }

        if ($invoked !== true) {
            $resolved = call_user_func($callableToInvoke);
        }

        $storedResult = $resolved;
        $this->values[$object][$hash] = $storedResult;

        return $storedResult;
    }

    /**
     * Re-enable the once instance if it was disabled.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function enable()
    {
        static::$enabled = true;
    }

    /**
     * Disable the once instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function disable()
    {
        static::$enabled = false;
    }

    /**
     * Flush the once instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public static function flush()
    {
        static::$instance = null;
    }
}
